_comment_paths: EDIT THESE: ms_data is the directory of .arrow files, library is the .poin path, results is where outputs go.
_comment_acquisition: Override per-instrument; nce is collision energy.
_comment_global: match_between_runs toggles MBR features. q_value_threshold is the cutoff for the final FDR.
_comment_search: n_isotopes=2 matches typical Olsen Exploris settings.
_comment_output: delete_temp=false keeps temp_data/ for post-hoc inspection (precursors_long.arrow, main_search_psms/, etc.). write_csv adds CSV alongside Arrow output.
_comment_proteinScoring: log_feature_importance dumps gain rankings for the protein-level model. global_protein_inference controls per-file vs experiment-wide.
